Mahesh Babu Kadiyala

Professional Summary:  
Data Engineering Manager with 14+ years of experience designing cloud-native batch and near real-

Lakehouse solutions supporting analytics and AI workloads.

• ETL & Data Integration: ADF, SSIS, Informatica, Delta Lake, Snowflake 
• Cloud & Data Platforms: Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Azure Event 
Hubs (Kafka-compatible), Delta Lake 
• Big Data & Processing: Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Data Warehousing 
• Machine Learning & AI: Azure ML, AutoML, Predictive Analytics, LLM’s 
• Data Quality & Governance: Unity Catalogue, Schema Validation, ACID Compliance, Data Versioning 
• DevOps & Performance Optimization: Azure DevOps (CI/CD), SQL Tuning, Query Optimization 
• Security & Compliance: Data Governance Policies, Key Vault, Secure Data Pipelines 
• Collaboration & Leadership: Cross-functional Team Management, Agile, Scrum 
Certifications & Education: 
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) 
• Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate (Power BI DA-100) 
• ITIL Foundation V3 | Lean Six Sigma - Yellow Belt Certified 
• PG Certification in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning – IIIT Hyderabad (Expected Jan 2026) 
• Master of Computer Applications – JNTUK (2008-2011)

Alliantgroup, India  Data Engineering Manager  (Mar’23 – Jul’25sandee)

• Developed & optimized 100+ SQL procedures and scripts for data transformation,

• Implemented Unity Catalog governance for Databricks assets by organizing data into

selection, hyperparameters, and feature engineering, reducing manual effort and

data from disparate source systems while adhering to the Medallion Architecture. The

enrichment in the silver layer, and transformed it into business-ready datasets in the gold 
layer for advanced analytics. 
• Designed and implemented near real-time data ingestion pipelines using Azure Event Hubs 
and Databricks Structured Streaming to continuously ingest application events into Delta 
Lake, enabling low -latency analytics and downstream reporting. Implemented

delivery.

into bronze, silver and gold delta tables. 
• Processed customer activity events (login, transactions, order updates and application

downstream analytics. 
• Optimized Transformations: Implemented PySpark -based transformations within 
Databricks notebooks, enabling parallel processing for high -volume datasets, reducing 
processing time by 40%. 
• Schema Evolution & Governance: Leveraged Delta Lake to enforce schema validation, 
maintain versioning, and ensure ACID compliance, improving data reliability. 
• Performance Tuning: Optimized Spark cluster configurations, caching strategies, and 
partitioning techniques to enhance query performance and minimize latency. 
• Business Intelligence & Reporting: Integrated refined Gold-layer data with Azure Synapse 
Analytics, enabling interactive Power BI dashboards and real-time reporting.
